notes: Measurement-only Windows test: Recipes > My Saved Recipes now offers Saved data timing. Choose Record next app launch, save and close normally, reopen within 15 minutes, visit My Saved Recipes, then Copy report before closing. Records fixed operation labels and timings only; no recipe contents, paths, identifiers, or uploads. Reports native read phases, IPC round trip, query completion and post-commit frame opportunity; not a performance fix. Existing storage, recovery, enrollment and updater safety remain unchanged. Public debug test build.
